15.t: Working with data: potato chips in sugar solutions
q: Read the change in mass in pure water (0).
Stronger sugar solution, the chip loses more mass; in weak solutions it gains mass.
Estimate the concentration where the mass does not change, and say what it means.
About 0.38 mol dm⁻³: the solution has the same water concentration as the potato cells (no net osmosis).
Explain why percentage change is used instead of change in grams.
The chips start at different masses; percentage change makes them comparable, so a bigger chip does not look like a bigger effect.
